description.value: Ba Le Sandwich Shop is a long-standing, family-run Vietnamese banh mi shop on Vancouver's Main Street, celebrated by regulars for its in-house baked baguette bread and remarkably affordable sandwiches. The space is intentionally minimal — just two small tables — making it almost entirely a takeout operation, well suited to a cyclist grabbing a quick, cheap meal on the go. Multiple reviewers note it has been a neighbourhood fixture for years and offers a genuinely casual, no-frills experience.
